prep.label: Before your first visit
prep.text: Complete the participant release and review the library’s guidelines. Bring an active library card and government photo ID.

prep.label: Book your station
prep.text: Use the library’s three-hour booking route. Ask how to save files for your exact format. The 8mm reel equipment uses an SD card with a size limit.

operators.name: Boston Public Library Central Memory Lab

prep.label: Before you request a reservation
prep.text: Complete the online orientation and use agreement. Boston requires a physical BPL or accepted MBLN card and excludes Minuteman cards and eCards.

prep.label: Choose a station
prep.text: VHS uses the audio-video station. Book one station in a three-hour session and wait for a confirmation email.

operators.name: Los Angeles Public Library DIY Memory Lab

prep.label: Before calling for a reservation
prep.text: Have a Los Angeles Public Library card in good standing, complete the online orientation and sign the required agreement.

prep.label: Choose one station
prep.text: The lab limits each appointment to one piece of equipment. Ask which storage device to bring for that particular station.

operators.name: Greater Victoria Public Library at Esquimalt

prep.label: What to bring
prep.text: Bring your library card and a USB or external drive with at least 32 GB of space. Audio users should bring wired headphones.

prep.label: Where and when
prep.text: Use the Esquimalt Branch reservation page. Sessions can be booked for one to three hours in one-hour increments.

operators.name: Coquitlam Public Library Poirier Digitization Station

prep.label: Before you reserve
prep.text: Use your library card to book the Poirier station. The published conversion options do not include PAL-to-NTSC conversion.

prep.label: If you want help
prep.text: The library provides self-serve instructions. It offers a separate help session for one-on-one orientation.

prep.label: Before you travel
prep.text: Call to check walk-in equipment availability. Reserve a Studio Station with your library card number and PIN.

prep.label: What the station supplies
prep.text: The hands-on lab may require your own camcorder and compatible cables for some formats. Check the equipment table for your media.
